infobox.effect: Provides 77 inventory slots while only taking up 6

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Key case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 77 inventory slots in a 11x7 grid and only takes up 6 inventory slot itself. It can only store:
- Keys & Keycards
- Key tool
- Gingy keychain
- Keycard holder case
